_instructions: Copy this template and fill in the fields. Submit via /submitpower command.

power.name: Power Name
power.description: Detailed description of what the power does in roleplay terms.
_effect_formats: damage:X - Deal X damage to boss (max 500)
heal:X - Heal X HP to self
heal_ally:X - Heal X HP to target ally
buff:type:value:duration - Apply buff (e.g., buff:damage:0.2:30 = +20% damage for 30s)
power._cooldown_notes: In seconds. Recommended: 30-120 for basic, 180-600 for powerful. Only ticks during fights!
power._image_notes: Optional GIF/image URL shown when power activates
power._trigger_notes: Optional phrase that triggers power when said in quotes (e.g., 'Domain Expansion')

balance_notes: GM will review and may adjust cooldown/effect values for game balance.
